makemeahanzi.definition: to terminate; to discard; to abgrogate

characterDeckComponents.note: 发 (fā) gives a sound related to fèi, sharing the initial f-, though the rhyme has drifted from ā to èi over time.

meanings: generic name for hemp, flax etc
hemp or flax fiber for textile materials

etymology.hint: Hemp plants 林 growing in a greenhouse 广

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (shelter) pictures a drying shed.
林-shaped strokes below picture hemp fibers hung to dry, giving 麻 its meaning 'hemp.'

meanings: to hang on in a place

makemeahanzi.definition: to depend on, to rely on; to bilk, to deny; poor

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (money, from ancient shell currency) — 赖 relates to depending on someone for support, as in 'to rely on.'
剌 (là) gives a sound close to lài, sharing the initial l- and a similar rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to supervise, to oversee, to direct

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — supervising, 督's meaning, involves watching closely.
叔 (shū) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading dū has diverged.
Hidden — an older semantic root linked to enclosure.
Gives the sound fú, related to rǔ but drifted apart over time.
口 (mouth) — 呗 is a sentence-final spoken particle.
贝 (bèi) gives a sound very close to 呗's reading bei, differing mainly in that 呗 is pronounced with a neutral tone.
疒 (sickness) — 痒 belongs to the group of characters describing bodily discomfort.
羊 (yáng) gives a sound close to yǎng, the same syllable with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to hold, to support, to sustain

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — relates directly to 持's meaning 'to hold, maintain.'
寺 (sì) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from chí.
氵 (water) shows 浓 relates to the concentration of a liquid.
农 (nóng) gives the exact sound of 浓.
心 (heart) — 怒 relates to strong feeling in the heart: anger.
奴 (nú) gives a sound close to nù, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.

etymology.hint: A hand holding a large carpenter's square 工

characterDeckComponents.note: 巨 depicts a hand gripping a large carpenter's square, a tool for measuring right angles — an image linked to great size, giving 巨 its meaning 'huge, giant.'

meanings: (in Qing times) Manchu (cf. 八旗[Ba1 qi2])

characterDeckComponents.note: 方 (here, a flagpole with streamers) — 旗 names a flag or banner flown from a pole.
其 (qí) gives the sound — an exact match with 旗.
⺼ (flesh/body) — 肾 refers to an internal organ, the kidney.

makemeahanzi.definition: to jump, to bounce on; bright

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 蹦 relates to an action done with the legs and feet.
崩 (bēng) gives a sound close to 蹦's reading bèng, differing only in tone.
Flesh — the belly is part of the body.
Gives the sound tǔ, related to dù but drifted apart over time.
氵 (water) — 源 originally referred to the spring where a river begins
原 (yuán) gives the sound — an exact match with 源's reading yuán

makemeahanzi.definition: to bathe, to shower, to wash

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 浴 relates to washing with water.
谷 (gǔ) gives a sound only distantly related to yù today, having drifted apart over time.
力 (strength) — 勃 describes a sudden burst of energy or strength.
孛 gives a sound closely related to bó, sharing the initial b-.
寿 evolved as an altered, simplified form of 老 (old), extending its meaning to 'long life, longevity.'
足 (foot) — 跪 describes an action done with the legs, kneeling.
危 (wēi) gives a sound distantly related to 跪's reading guì, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to fry in fat or oil; to boil in water

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 煎 relates to cooking with heat.
前 (qián) gives a sound distantly related to 煎's reading jiān, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (in 堪輿|堪舆[kan1 yu2]) heaven (contrasted with earth 輿|舆[yu2])

etymology.hint: One with a considerable amount 甚 of land 土

characterDeckComponents.note: Earth/land — represents property or wealth.
Suggests a great amount, linked to being 'worthy' or 'able to bear.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to coax; to beguile, to cheat, to deceive; tumult, uproar

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 哄 describes a noise made by many mouths at once.
共 (gòng) gives a sound distantly related to hōng, having drifted apart over time.
犭 (dog) shows 猎 relates to hunting with animals.
昔 (xī) gives a sound distantly related to liè, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: a large string instrument; to tremble, to vibrate

characterDeckComponents.note: 玨 (two connected jade pieces, standing in for strings) shows 瑟 relates to a stringed instrument.
必 (bì) gives a sound distantly related to sè, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Picture of a tongue with 一 marking the sweet spot

makemeahanzi.definition: to peel, to skin; to exploit

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — peeling is done with a blade or the fingers acting like one.
录 (lù) gives a sound distantly related to bō, having drifted apart over time.
义 (yì) gives a sound close to yí, differing only in tone.
犭 (animal) — 猴 names an animal, the monkey.
侯 (hóu) gives the sound — an exact match with 猴.

makemeahanzi.definition: to smoke, to cure meat; vapor, smoke, fog

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 熏 relates to smoke and fumes rising from fire.

makemeahanzi.definition: to honor, to respect, to venerate

etymology.hint: A hand 寸 making an offering of wine 酋

characterDeckComponents.note: 酋 pictures a jar of wine.
寸 (hand) below offers it up respectfully, giving 尊 its meaning 'to respect, to honor.'

meanings: to gather together, pool or collect

characterDeckComponents.note: 冫 (ice) — an old sense of 凑 involved condensing or coming together, like moisture forming.
奏 (zòu) gives a sound close to còu, sharing the same rhyme and a related initial.

meanings: (bound form) burger (abbr. for 漢堡|汉堡[han4 bao3])

etymology.hint: Earthen 土 walls built for defense 保; 保 also provides the meaning

characterDeckComponents.note: 保 (to protect) — 堡 describes a structure built for defense.
土 (earth) — earthen 土 walls built for defense 保 gave 堡 its meaning 'fort, fortress.'

makemeahanzi.definition: failure; to decline, to fail, to suffer defeat

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (a striking hand) — 败 relates to being struck down or defeated.
贝 (bèi) gives a sound close to bài, sharing the same initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: both, and; at the same time; to unite, to combine

etymology.hint: A hand holding two sheafs of grain 禾

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain), doubled here — 兼 pictures two stalks of grain held together.
彐 depicts a hand grasping — a hand 彐 holding two sheafs of grain 禾禾 at once gave 兼 its meaning 'to combine, to hold two things together.'
Tree — a peach grows on a tree.
Gives the sound zhào, related to táo but drifted apart over time.

meanings: (after 不[bu4] or 只[zhi3] or 何[he2] etc) to need

makemeahanzi.definition: news, rumors; to die out, to melt away, to vanish

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates to 消's meaning 'to disappear, dissolve,' like something dissolving in water.
肖 (xiào) gives a sound hint — 消 is pronounced xiāo, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.
日 (sun) — 显 relates to something bright and clearly visible in the light
业 (yè) gives a loose sound connection to 显's reading xiǎn
木 (wood/tree) — 朴 originally named a type of tree.
卜 (bǔ) gives a sound close to pǔ, sharing the same rhyme.

meanings: variant of 琴[qin2], guqin or zither

makemeahanzi.definition: Chinese lute or guitar, string instrument

etymology.hint: Two guitar strings 玨 suggest the meaning; 今 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 玨 (two connected jade pieces, representing strings) at the top shows the instrument's strings.
今 at the bottom rounds out the character's shape, giving 琴 its meaning 'a stringed instrument.'
钅 (metal) — an older semantic link to money made of metal.
旁 (páng) gives a sound close to bàng, sharing the same final.

meanings: used in 蝦蟆|虾蟆[ha2 ma5]

characterDeckComponents.note: 虫 (insect/small creature) — 虾 names a small water creature.
下 (xià) gives a sound close to 虾's reading xiā, differing only in tone.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 薑; grass 艹 provides the meaning while 畺 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 姜 is the simplified form of 薑, which combined a grass radical (艹, for the ginger plant) with a separate part supplying the sound; in the modern simplified shape (羊 over 女), that original plant picture has been lost.
豕 (boar) — 豪 originally described a fierce, bristling boar-like porcupine, extending to 'heroic, grand.'
高 (gāo) shares the rhyme -ao with háo, though the initial has drifted from g- to h- over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: the Tang dynasty; Chinese; empty, exaggerated; surname

etymology.hint: Children learning how to read 口 and write 肀 in school 广

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 depicts a roofed building, a school or hall.
肀 depicts a hand holding a writing brush.
口 (mouth) — children reading aloud and writing in school gave 唐 its early meaning, later borrowed as the name of the Tang dynasty.

makemeahanzi.definition: equal, even, fair; level, uniform; also, too

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 均 relates to leveling land evenly.
匀 (yún) gives a rhyme close to jūn, with the initial shifted.
贝 (shell, an ancient form of currency) — 质 originally meant 'pledge, hostage,' something valuable given as a guarantee, extended to 'quality, substance, nature.'
十 (shí) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from zhì.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drift, to float; mobile, temporary, unstable; reckless

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 浮 describes something floating on water.
孚 (fú) gives the sound — an exact match with 浮.
